highlights: Earn up to 1.25 miles per dollar on local spend and up to 2.25 miles per dollar on overseas spend, with a minimum S$50,000 eligible spend in the first 12 months to qualify for the Step Up Earn Rate. For other spending, earn 1 mile per dollar.

pros: Borrow up to 90% of your available credit limit, enjoy interest rates as low as 2.6% p.a., and get flexible payment terms up to 60 months when you apply with promo code 
CIPSS
. 
T&Cs apply.
pros: Base earn rates of 1 mile per S$1 on local spend and 2 miles per S$1 in foreign spend.
pros: Step Up earn rates of 1.25 miles per S$1 on local spend and 2.25 miles per S$1 in foreign spend with min. S$50,000 eligible purchases within first 12 months of card issuance date.
pros: Regular cardholders: 2x complimentary expedited immigration clearance per calendar year, thereafter min. S$2,000 eligible spend in a calendar month to qualify.
pros: Regular cardholders: 2x complimentary airport limousine service per calendar year, thereafter min. S$2,000 eligible spend in a calendar month to qualify (capped at 24 usages per calendar year).
pros: HSBC Premier customers: 4x complimentary expedited immigration clearance and airport limousine service each per calendar year.
pros: Unlimited airport lounge access for primary and supplementary cardholders.
pros: Up to US$2 million complimentary travel insurance coverage (including up to US$100,000 for COVID-19).
pros: Complimentary concierge services for travel, golfing, dining, shopping, and business assistance.
pros: Exclusive discounts on retail, dining, hotel stays, and more offers.
cons: US$35 per guest per visit for airport lounge access.
cons: HSBC Rewards Points expire after 37 months.
cons: S$43.20 annual Mileage Programme fee (convert points into KrisFlyer and/or Asia Miles).
cons: Expensive annual fee of S$656.08 for everyone, but S$492.56 annual fee reserved for HSBC Premier customers only.

extra.description: The HSBC Visa Infinite Credit Card offers unmatched luxury, personalized services, and exclusive privileges for discerning individuals. Enjoy up to 2.25 miles on your spending and a suite of exclusive travel privileges.
